description: 60 word-specific independent editorial and pronunciation review tasks; URLs are unvisited leads.

english_definition_review.task: Independently check exact English sense, part of speech and original definition with authoritative source; record URL, access date and reviewer.

burmese_review.task: Independent Burmese editor must check natural meaning, register and precise English sense match.

example_review.task: Independently check grammar, collocation, originality and exact intended sense.

cefr_review.task: Check word-specific and sense-specific CEFR level. Quarantine or reclassify any unsupported frequency-based level; C1 especially suspect.

audio_review.task: After text approval, generate and listen-check George/Emma word and example recordings; test physical iPhone Safari.
